title: My Footprints Stop at the River
summary: An eleven-year-old finds tomorrow’s footprints leading to the river. That night, much larger bare prints return to the door and his own footprints change.
caption: title-only
frame_0: A worried boy in a mustard jumper stands at his cottage doorway. Cyan-white boot prints cross blue snow, reach the black river and stop beneath a cloud-ringed moon.
package_differences: Jake approved the original Reflection cast and brighter moonlit picture. The boy wears a mustard jumper. The school memories show him carrying his primer.
The opening uses steady shots. The single moving camera follows the bare prints from the river to the door, then returns to the window along the drag marks.
The film uses the supplied narration, sparse contact effects and quiet under the final line. The sponsor version continues into the 9.30-second phone ending. The clean edition ends at the window.
camera: steady opening, then one continuous glide
